summary: Attempt-to-locate and welfare check after a caller reported a female crying for help out the passenger window of an older model red truck at South Chester and Belle Terrace, with a male hanging out the driver's window. The truck was last seen traveling southbound.

Possible road-rage disturbance: a blue Honda with paper plates and a white pickup traveling eastbound on White Lane repeatedly stopping and blocking the roadway. City units broadcast for a 415 vehicle.
Stolen vehicle report on Kentucky Street: a white 2001 Dodge van with California plates taken from the area.
Units broadcast on a 23152 southbound on I-5 south of Grapevine: a newer black pickup at speeds over 90, passing on the shoulder, with the driver seen drinking from an open container.

area: Flying J truck stop, Frazier Park
summary: Traffic collision at the Flying J parking lot: a burgundy Freightliner was struck by a red Peterbilt that left the scene; the other party denied involvement.
Theft reported from a space at a mobile home park on Barlow Road; loss estimated at roughly $3,900. A suspect who lives in the same park was named on the air.
Residential fire alarm at a Greenview Lane home, reported by the residents.
Traffic unit requested for the 600 block of 33rd Street.
